summary: Static Banner and Lightbox Billboard Features - All Tests Passed. Implemented State → Road → Type selection system for Static Banner and Lightbox billboards. Backend APIs work correctly, Admin panel has new Static/Lightbox tab with category toggle, and frontend modals show correct dropdowns based on billboard type.
seed_data_creation: Sample data exists: Kano state with Zoo Road, Standard Vinyl and Premium Flex types for Static Banner, Backlit Standard and Premium LED Backlit types for Lightbox, with packages for each.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static Banner and Lightbox billboard features are fully functional. Key points: 1) Billboards page shows 3 main categories (LED, Static Banner, Lightbox), 2) LED modal shows Size dropdown, Static/Lightbox modals show Type dropdown, 3) Admin panel has 'Static/Lightbox' tab with category toggle between Static Banner and Lightbox, 4) Orders can be placed for static_banner and lightbox listing types with supplier_id='lightban-platform'.
